lessons.title: Lesson 1
lessons.description: Learn to write simple programs. Verify the programming environment setup.

lessons.title: Lesson 2
lessons.description: Study variables and data types. Write a program that outputs a name and age.

lessons.title: Lesson 3
lessons.description: Learn operations on numbers. Create an addition and subtraction calculator.

lessons.title: Lesson 4
lessons.description: Study conditional operators (if, else). Write a program that determines whether a number is even.

lessons.title: Lesson 5
lessons.description: Get acquainted with loops (for, while). Create a program that counts from 1 to 10.

lessons.title: Lesson 6
lessons.description: Learn about lists. Write a program that stores friends' names and displays them.

lessons.title: Lesson 7
lessons.description: Get acquainted with functions. Create a function that greets a user by name.

lessons.title: Lesson 8
lessons.description: Learn about dictionaries. Write a program that stores information about favourite toys.

lessons.title: Lesson 9
lessons.description: Learn about error handling. Write a program that asks for a number and handles input errors.

lessons.title: Lesson 10
lessons.description: Create your own small project: the 'Guess the Number' game.
